visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shows hands in blue nitrile gloves using a T-shaped wooden spreader to rotate green matcha batter on a flat black circular griddle. The background is a clean, stainless-steel commercial kitchen with white containers. (2) Hands wearing black gloves are seen folding a cooked crepe filled with thick white whipped cream, green matcha cream stripes, sliced red strawberries, and small white mochi pieces. (3) A sequence of close-ups showcases various completed crepes: one with a burnt caramel crust on top, another topped with dark boba pearls, green matcha jelly cubes, and white crispy bits. (4) The assembly process continues on the griddle surface, showing the addition of cream, strawberries, matcha chocolate bars, and various toppings. (5) A handheld blowtorch is used to melt and caramelize a layer of yellow sugar on top of a crepe held in a green paper sleeve. (6) The camera shifts to a retail environment. A staff member in a uniform, mask, and yellow cap hands a cup of orange gelato to a customer. The final shot shows the storefront of 'Fun Tower' in a bright shopping mall food court.
